name: What is the process for a full siding replacement from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a full siding replacement from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation and estimate. Once materials are selected, we prepare the site by removing old siding and inspecting the sub-structure for any repairs. New house wrap is installed for moisture protection, followed by the installation of the chosen siding material, trim, and flashing. Finally, a thorough cleanup is performed, and a final inspection ensures quality and client satisfaction. We manage every step to ensure a smooth and efficient project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, old siding removal, sub-structure inspection, house wrap installation, new siding installation, trim, cleanup, and final inspection.
